material.description: The reference shop has a pinned-items strip, a component tree for the selected item, and a Grab all action beside Stash. shop_tree renders a pinned placeholder and a stash bar only. Needs: a select-item call and a pin call handled in on_action (scenarios/moba/panels.lua, outside shop_tree), and a grab-all call that takes every stash slot out. Ownership: panels.lua on_action and store.lua. Acceptance: pins persist per hero; the selected item's recipe tree renders from its components; Grab all unstashes every slot; buy, sell and unstash keep working.

notes.note: Done in scratch: Pin per card and pinned strip (PINS per hero kind), Recipe tree of the picked item (SHOP_PICK), Grab all (grab_all, stash slots taken descending). Blocker: no live match is reachable in a browser without Claim, Fill, Start or a room join, all forbidden by the owner. Owner to approve a local route (fixture or bot seating that clicks none of those) to witness the in-match behaviour.
